latest_news.headline: Bloomberg reports India-Pakistan warship collision and competing protests
latest_news.text: Bloomberg reporting carried by The Japan Times attributes a September 15 collision in the northern Arabian Sea to accounts from both sides. India and Pakistan summoned each other’s diplomats and dispute responsibility. India says no major damage occurred. The original ministry statements were not retrieved; this is attributed reporting, not independent operational verification or a newly occurring September 17 collision.
latest_news.implication: The reported collision has prompted reciprocal diplomatic protests; responsibility remains disputed and no major damage is reported by India.

latest_news.headline: Reuters: North Korean vice defence minister reiterates nuclear-force expansion
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Vice Defence Minister Kim Kang Il said at the Xiangshan forum that a US arms buildup justified strengthening North Korea’s nuclear forces. The underlying speech transcript and independent corroboration were not retrieved. This is an attributed policy statement, not verified weapons deployment, warhead loading or a nuclear test.
latest_news.implication: The statement reiterates nuclear-deterrent expansion policy; it does not establish an operational change.

latest_news.headline: IRGC claims US MQ-9 downing over Qeshm; no US confirmation in reporting
latest_news.text: Anadolu, Iranian state broadcaster Press TV and Iran International relay the IRGC claim that air defences downed a US MQ-9 over Qeshm at 02:29 local time on September 16. Anadolu reports no immediate US comment. All three share IRGC attribution, not independent operational verification; the original IRGC publication was not retrieved. The claimed cumulative total of 52 MQ-9s is unverified and is not adopted. The local event time is retained as attributed; Anadolu gives a slightly inconsistent UTC conversion, so exact UTC event time remains unknown. No evidenced link to the previously retained report of explosion sounds is established. Newly reviewed earlier reporting, not a new attack established in the three-hour scan.
latest_news.implication: The attributed claim concerns a US surveillance drone; loss, cumulative totals and any connection to earlier explosion reports remain unverified.

latest_news.headline: Ukrainian officials report five killed in September 16 Nikopol minibus strike
latest_news.text: Reuters, AP and Anadolu report Ukrainian official statements that an early September 16 drone strike on a passenger minibus near Nikopol killed five people and injured seven. Reuters explicitly says it did not verify the governor’s image. The outlets share official attribution, not independent operational verification; the underlying presidential and police publications were not retrieved. This is newly reviewed earlier reporting, not a new attack established within this three-hour scan. Separate railway attacks reported in the same articles are not merged into this incident.
latest_news.implication: The attributed casualty report concerns civilian passenger transport; responsibility and casualty figures lack independent verification in the reviewed evidence.

latest_news.headline: Saudi coalition reports intercepting drone toward Mecca; Houthis deny threatening holy sites
latest_news.text: Al Jazeera Staff and Reuters reporting published September 16 attributes a Tuesday-evening drone interception to coalition spokesman Turki al-Maliki. It reports short-lived alerts in Mecca, Taif and Jeddah and quotes a Houthi military source through SABA denying threats to Mecca or other holy sites. Exact event and publication times are unknown. Underlying coalition and SABA statements were not retrieved. This is attributed and disputed reporting, not independent confirmation of the drone origin or intended target, and not a newly timed attack within this scan.
latest_news.implication: The report juxtaposes a Saudi interception claim with a Houthi denial; intended target and origin are not independently established.

latest_news.headline: Reuters: preliminary tracking counted four Hormuz transits on September 15
latest_news.text: Reuters reports four preliminary vessel transits on September 15, two entering and two exiting, down from seven a day earlier. Ships sailing with transponders off may not be counted. This is newly reviewed earlier reporting, not a new closure or incident established within this scan. Underlying shipping data were not retrieved; no independent verification is claimed.
latest_news.implication: The preliminary count indicates restricted traffic, not zero traffic or a verified closure; vessels with transponders off may be omitted.

latest_news.headline: AP reports Saudi-Egyptian talks on Red Sea maritime security; no concrete steps announced
latest_news.text: Associated Press reporting republished by NBC, timestamped September 15 at 9:32 PM EDT, reports Mohammed bin Salman met Abdel-Fattah el-Sissi in Cairo on September 15. It quotes statements supporting maritime navigation and Saudi Arabia, but says neither side gave firm details on future steps. The underlying September statements were not retrieved; the presidency homepage returned older material. AP syndication is one reporting origin, not independent corroboration. No Egyptian combat deployment or new defence commitment is established.
latest_news.implication: Reported political support does not establish an Egyptian military commitment; the account supplies no firm operational next steps.

latest_news.headline: Reuters relays IRNA report of explosion sounds on Qeshm
latest_news.text: Reuters published September 15 at 22:23 UTC, with a September 16 dateline, relays IRNA citing local sources who heard several explosions on Qeshm and said sounds appeared to come from the sea. Cause, responsible actor, damage and exact event time are not established in this report. The underlying IRNA publication was not retrieved; syndication does not independently confirm the incident.
latest_news.implication: No further implication established by this evidence.

latest_news.headline: September 15 energy strikes reported despite proposed Russia-Ukraine pause
latest_news.text: Newly reviewed September 15 reporting, not a newly timed attack within this scan. NBC attributes Russian drone strikes on Ukrainian energy and port facilities to Ukrainian officials and a strike on the Syzran refinery to Ukraine’s military. Ukrainska Pravda quotes Zelenskyy reporting Syzran, Taganrog and Oryol strikes. These overlapping official claims are not independent operational verification. NBC reports the Kremlin described the energy-strike pause as a proposal still under discussion. The underlying September 15 presidential social post was not retrieved; an undated presidential energy-strike address retrieved in this scan is not used to corroborate the event date. Damage and attack totals remain attributed.
latest_news.implication: Reported energy strikes continued after the proposed pause; the reporting does not establish that a mutual halt was implemented.

latest_news.headline: Reuters: coalition reports 13 civilians wounded in renewed Houthi attacks
latest_news.text: The retrieved opening of the September 15 Reuters report says the Houthis claimed Monday missile and drone attacks on the Khamis Mushait airbase. Reuters attributes 13 civilian injuries in the attacks to the Saudi-led coalition and reports emergency alerts in Khamis Mushait and three other southern cities. The remainder of the article and the underlying coalition statement were not retrieved. Military target damage and civilian injuries are not independently verified. This is newly reviewed reporting of September 14 attacks, not a newly verified attack within this scan.
latest_news.implication: The coalition-attributed injury report describes civilian consequences of renewed attacks; claimed damage to the airbase remains unverified.

latest_news.headline: Zelenskyy conditions energy-strike pause on credible Russian restraint
latest_news.text: Reuters and POLITICO report September 14 statements in which Zelenskyy offers reciprocal restraint if partners secure genuine Russian willingness to stop attacks on Ukrainian energy and critical infrastructure. Trump separately claimed an agreement; the retrieved reporting does not establish an implemented mutual ceasefire. The official social-media statement could not be read directly. The outlets share attribution to presidential statements, not independent verification of a cessation. Newly reviewed earlier reporting, not a new attack in this scan.
latest_news.implication: Ukraine’s offer is conditional; the statements do not establish an implemented mutual halt to energy strikes.
latest_news.next_trigger: Zelenskyy says Ukraine awaits specifics from partners on a reliable, long-term arrangement.

latest_news.headline: ArcelorMittal reports fatal missile strike and halted primary steel production
latest_news.text: Reuters reports on September 14 that ArcelorMittal says a September 12 ballistic missile strike killed two contractors and injured two employees at Kryvyi Rih. The company statement distributed via GlobeNewswire and carried by FinancialContent says ironmaking complex #1 was hit, primary steel production is halted, and other facilities are idled or operating minimally. Both full texts were reviewed; Reuters shares company attribution and does not independently verify the attack. Exact attack time and restoration date remain unknown. This is newly reviewed reporting of a September 12 event, not a new attack in the three-hour scan window.
latest_news.implication: The company reports halted primary steel production while damage and repairs are assessed; the restart date remains unknown.
latest_news.next_trigger: The company says further operational updates will follow completed damage assessments and clearer repair timelines.

latest_news.headline: Reuters: Iranian strait authority lists 77 vessels for threatened passage restrictions
latest_news.text: Reuters attributes an updated list of 77 vessels to Iran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority on Monday. The body says listed vessels face future passage restrictions including fines, detention or confiscation; cooperating vessels could be added and insurers/P&I clubs/classification societies are warned against providing services. This is an attributed policy announcement, not verified enforcement, seizure or closure. The original X post and vessel list were not retrieved. No independent confirmation or explicit next trigger established.
latest_news.implication: The reported list threatens future passage restrictions, fines, detention or confiscation; it does not establish that any listed vessel has been seized or the strait closed.

latest_news.headline: Oman postpones Salalah regional meeting to a later date
latest_news.text: Oman Foreign Ministry publication dated September 13 says the regional meeting scheduled for Monday in Salalah is postponed to a later date to create conditions for constructive dialogue. The ministry-hosted English text is identified as an unofficial translation of its Arabic report. Reuters also attributes postponement to the foreign minister; this is shared official attribution, not independent verification. No replacement date is supplied. This is newly reviewed reporting, not a new attack during this scan.
latest_news.implication: The planned regional dialogue will not take place on Monday as scheduled; the notice does not establish an end to diplomacy or any change in shipping access.

latest_news.headline: UKMTO update reports fire and crew evacuation after Hormuz vessel strike
latest_news.text: Anadolu and Middle East Eye report a UKMTO update describing fire aboard the previously reported Hormuz vessel and local authorities assisting crew evacuation. Both full reports were reviewed. They share UKMTO attribution and are not independent verification. Middle East Eye identifies Warning 134-26 Update 001 and publishes at 10:49 BST on September 13. Anadolu says UKMTO received the initial report at 23:00 UTC on September 12; this is a report-receipt time, not the strike time. The underlying bulletin was not retrieved from the official website. Exact strike time, vessel identity, casualties, damage extent and environmental effects remain unknown. The separately reported Hengam/Qeshm casualties cannot safely be identified as this incident. This revises the existing incident rather than establishing a new attack in this scan.
latest_news.implication: The reported fire and evacuation extend the known consequences of the retained vessel strike; casualty totals, damage extent and responsibility remain unverified.
latest_news.next_trigger: UKMTO says an investigation is underway; its findings remain pending.
latest_news.material_revision: UKMTO update reports an onboard fire and local authorities assisting crew evacuation.

latest_news.headline: UKMTO reports vessel struck by unidentified projectile in Hormuz
latest_news.text: Anadolu reports a September 13 UKMTO statement that a vessel transiting the Strait of Hormuz was struck by an unidentified munition. Crew condition, damage and environmental impact were unknown; an investigation was underway. The full Anadolu article was reviewed. Retrieved Reuters/AFP reporting carried by RTE also attributes a projectile report to UKMTO, but shares the same official attribution and is not independent confirmation. The underlying UKMTO notice was not retrieved. No vessel name or exact event time is established. A separate Iranian report of casualties near Qeshm cannot safely be identified as this same incident. This is newly reviewed reporting, not a verified attack within the three-hour scan window.
latest_news.implication: The attributed notice identifies a reported strike on commercial shipping; casualties, damage, responsibility and any effect on passage remain unverified.
latest_news.next_trigger: UKMTO says an investigation is underway; its findings remain pending.

latest_news.headline: Rosatom chief alleges September 11 attack on Zaporizhzhia diesel deliveries
latest_news.text: Reuters and TASS report on September 13 that Rosatom chief Alexei Likhachev accused Ukraine of September 11 strikes on diesel fuel trucks near the Zaporizhzhia plant perimeter, killing two Russian servicemen and injuring others. TASS quotes the Rosatom statement; Reuters syndication was also read. This is shared official attribution, not independent verification. The original Rosatom-hosted statement was not retrieved. The IAEA September 11 update, read via UN OCHA, separately says restored external power eased blackout risk but depleted diesel reserves need replenishment; it does not verify this attack allegation. This is newly reviewed reporting of an earlier event, not a new attack in this scan.
latest_news.implication: The allegation concerns fuel deliveries needed for backup cooling power; responsibility, casualties and the effect on plant reserves remain unverified.

latest_news.headline: AFP/AP report Lebanon-Israel Rome talks postponed until October
latest_news.text: AFP and AP reporting carried by Al Jazeera says the September round of US-mediated Rome talks has been postponed until October, citing an unnamed US official. President Aoun said there would be no new negotiations at the moment. The same official said ambassadors would meet at the US State Department next week on the June framework. The full article was reviewed; the underlying official statements were not retrieved. This is attributed reporting, not independent confirmation of a ceasefire or an end to diplomatic contact. Exact event and publication times are unknown.
latest_news.implication: The reported postponement delays the next Rome round, but planned ambassador-level contact means diplomacy has not been shown to end.
latest_news.next_trigger: The cited US official says ambassadors will meet at the State Department next week; the meeting and any outcome remain unconfirmed.

latest_news.headline: South Korea reports short-range North Korean missile launches from Wonsan
latest_news.text: AFP reporting carried by The Star attributes multiple short-range ballistic missile launches from Wonsan and flights of about 250 km to South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff. It reports that US Pacific Command assessed no immediate threat to US territory or allies. The full report was reviewed; original military statements were not retrieved and launch details are not independently verified. The article describes a prior-day launch, not a newly timed event within this scan. It does not establish a nuclear test or warhead loading.
latest_news.implication: The reported launches follow trilateral exercises; the cited US assessment does not identify an immediate threat to US territory or allies.

event_forecast.explanation: Numeric event predictions are withheld until event definitions, time horizons, resolution rules and independent validation gates pass. Withheld means unknown, not zero risk. Inherited signal scores are not calibrated event probabilities.

source_limitations: Source coverage and corroboration have not been independently verified for this build. Official releases are preferred for attributable actions; reputable reporting may add context. Headline indexes, repeated reports and market prices are not independent confirmation. Missing or stale reports do not establish calm. Single-source claims remain unverified.

publication_health.meaning: Build completion does not validate source freshness or forecast quality.

severity.aggregation: sum(valid component × positive configured weight) / sum(included weights)
severity.discontinuity: New series; legacy raw sum archived unchanged

review_capacity.status: planned capacity; no staffing or completed reviews asserted

evaluation.reason: No predeclared numeric probability/baseline model or independent evaluation design. Counts and elapsed time never unlock calibration.

event_definition.threshold: At least one confirmed direct exchange of weapons fire between Russian armed forces and armed forces of a NATO member in the frozen membership list; both sides fire. Ukraine-only conventional action, rhetoric, exercises, accidents, proxy-only action and interceptions without an exchange are excluded.
event_definition.time_window: issued_at < event <= deadline; complete closure duration must fit inside window
event_definition.source_rule: Full attributable source text reviewed; exact publisher/HTTPS host match plus event-specific facts. Operator verification is an attestation, not independent automated verification.
event_definition.negative_rule: Only after deadline, source explicitly covers the entire window and affirms no qualifying event; absence of news is insufficient.
event_definition.unresolvable_rule: Missing/conflicting coverage or source facts remain unresolved/ambiguous, never false.
